formal_call_frame.status: explicit adapter ABI; no original instruction reads either stack argument
formal_call_frame.ret_evidence: The reconstructed formal adapter ends in RET 0x10 on x86-32.

raw_entry_frame.ret_evidence: The original body ends in RET without an immediate cleanup at 0x004ae25a.
raw_entry_frame.effective_direct_call_shape: All 20 direct call sites load ECX and call without argument setup for the call; the body never reads ESP.

abi.unresolved_sdk_conflict: The SDK and imported Ghidra signature associate a signed index and 12-byte ColorRGB value with SetColor, while the executable body and all direct calls expose only ECX. The reconstruction preserves the formal frame in a no-op adapter and the exact ECX-only bytes in a separate raw entry without assigning setter semantics.

behavior.null_this: Safe: ECX is copied to a local slot but is never dereferenced.
behavior.index: The raw entry does not read a stack index. The formal adapter accepts a signed int at ESP+4 and ignores it; no bounds or success semantics are assigned.
behavior.color: The raw entry does not read a stack color. The formal adapter accepts a 12-byte ColorRGB at ESP+8 and ignores it; no component write or conversion is assigned.
behavior.model_fields: No EditorModel field is read or written, including mColors at +0xa4.
behavior.return: Void; no status, sentinel, error, or EAX assignment is produced by the target instructions.

layout_evidence: The target stores ECX at [EBP-4] and never dereferences it.
EditorModel is 0xe0 bytes in live Ghidra; its mColors[3] field is at +0xa4, but the target does not access that offset.
The SDK declaration names int index.
The target has no index comparison, sign extension, shift, or multiply instruction.
The SDK declaration names ColorRGB color by value.
Live Ghidra resolves ColorRGB to three floats at offsets 0, 4, and 8.
The target has no stack read or float instruction.

evidence.fact: Decompilation is an immediate empty void body.
The seven-instruction body only establishes and restores a frame, spills ECX, and returns; it has no loads from this or the stack, no branches, no calls, and no field access.
The first 11 bytes are 55 8b ec 51 89 4d fc 8b e5 5d c3, followed by CC padding.
The target has zero referenced globals.
Live Ghidra reports size 0xe0 and ColorRGB mColors[3] at offset 0xa4; the target never loads this+0xa4 or another model field.
Live Ghidra reports size 12 with float r/g/b at offsets 0/4/8.

Sixteen direct caller functions contain twenty unconditional calls. Representative disassembly at 0x0044d951, 0x0047fcd5, 0x004b7669, and 0x00588791 loads ECX immediately before CALL and does not push the formal index or color.
Besides the twenty code calls, ten undefined 32-bit data slots contain the target pointer; no callee, string, immediate-value, or function-global dependency was found.
The open SDK declares void SetColor(int index, ColorRGB color), supplies the formal signed 32-bit index and 12-byte by-value color, and places ColorRGB mColors[3] at +0xa4.
Nearby canonical source performs a bounded write, but it is not used to override the direct target's observed empty body and is outside the assigned writable scope.

steps: Expose editor_model_set_color_raw with the evidence-backed ECX-only entry and preserve the exact 11-byte body at 0x004ae250.
Expose the formal __thiscall adapter with receiver in ECX, signed int index at ESP+4, and 12-byte ColorRGB at ESP+8.
Have the formal adapter forward only the receiver to the raw entry while preserving RET 0x10 cleanup and ignoring both formal arguments.
Perform no null check, model-field load, model-field store, color write, bounds check, call to an original dependency, or branch in the raw body.
reconstructed_mechanics.test_scope: The focused i686 test binds the formal three-parameter function-pointer ABI, checks raw null and near-null calls, calls the formal adapter with null and near-null receivers, exercises indices -1, 0, 2, 3, INT_MIN, and INT_MAX, verifies all 0xe0 model bytes including the +0xa4 color-field start remain unchanged, and preserves ColorRGB offsets 0/4/8. The x86 object check verifies raw bytes 55 8b ec 51 89 4d fc 89 ec 5d c3 and formal RET 0x10.

unresolved_questions: Why do all observed direct calls and ten pointer-table entries use an ECX-only shape when the SDK/Ghidra formal signature has a 16-byte explicit argument area?
Is 0x004ae250 an intentionally empty callback/base implementation despite the SDK SetColor address association, or is the imported symbol mapping incomplete?
What concrete owners correspond to the ten undefined pointer-table entries?
Do any callers depend on EAX retaining its incoming value, even though the target itself does not write EAX?
blockers: The executable body supports only a no-op contract; it contains no evidence for color assignment, bounds checks, sentinels, or errors.

The SDK formal signature and raw ECX-only executable entry disagree on explicit argument presence, so the package keeps a formal no-op adapter separate from the exact raw body without claiming setter semantics.
The ten data pointer slots are unnamed and untyped in live Ghidra, so concrete owner and interface semantics remain unresolved.
